allow: PowerShell($d = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude"; if \(Test-Path $d\) { Get-ChildItem $d -Force | ForEach-Object { $_.Name } } else { "no .claude dir" }; "---"; if \(Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude.json"\) { "claude.json exists" } else { "no claude.json" })

PowerShell($j = Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; "Top-level keys:"; $j.PSObject.Properties.Name; "---"; if \($j.mcpServers\) { "mcpServers found at top level"; $j.mcpServers.PSObject.Properties.Name } else { "no top-level mcpServers" })

PowerShell($j = Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $proj = $j.projects.'c:\\Development\\OU\\navigate'; if \($proj\) { "Project keys:"; $proj.PSObject.Properties.Name } else { "project not in claude.json" })

PowerShell($j = Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $proj = $j.projects.'c:/Development/OU/navigate'; if \($proj.mcpServers\) { "Current mcpServers in this project:"; $proj.mcpServers | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 } else { "no mcpServers configured for this project" }; "---"; "User-level scope check:"; $u = $j.projects.'C:/Users/DavidCiocoiu'; if \($u.mcpServers\) { $u.mcpServers | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 } else { "none" })

PowerShell($path = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude.json"; $j = Get-Content $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $context7 = [PSCustomObject]@{ type = "stdio"; command = "npx"; args = @\("-y", "@upstash/context7-mcp"\) }; if \($j.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains "mcpServers"\) { $j.mcpServers | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "context7" -NotePropertyValue $context7 -Force } else { $j | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "mcpServers" -NotePropertyValue \([PSCustomObject]@{ context7 = $context7 }\) -Force }; \($j | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 100\) | Out-File -FilePath $path -Encoding utf8 -NoNewline; "wrote mcpServers.context7"; "---"; \(Get-Content $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json\).mcpServers | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5)
